scientific_question: Does the BHSM seam-charge scaling transfer where raw counts and linear K-band luminosity weighting failed?
bhsm_source_chain: therefore V_Sigma^4 = xi_c G M_b c^2 / R_H
mass_proxy_assumption: M_b proportional to L_K with no fitted mass-to-light exponent
foreground_visibility: only shell path length in front of the SN contributes
controls: same fixed axis, host-mass if available, survey dummies
primary_statistic: Delta chi2 beyond fixed-axis plus nuisance controls
permutation: same redshift-blocked shuffle used in the two prior frozen foreground tests

classification.strong: blocked permutation p < 0.01 and sign stable under every leave-one-shell-out test

secondary_transfer: fit one foreground amplitude at 0.01<=z<=0.03 and carry it unchanged to 0.03<z<=0.15
claim_boundary: This is a BHSM seam-charge proxy, not an action-normalized de-encapsulation map.
K-band luminosity is only a baryonic-mass proxy.
No SMBH mass or accretion information is used.
The exponent 1/2 comes from the retained seam-radius plus seam-charge relations and is not fit to SN residuals.
